notes.title: Update v0.4.250330
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45422672/e5c291f439fb78bc37478548e492068606f41355.png[/img]

[u][b]IMPORTANT! [/b][/u]
Items can behave incorrectly if there are multiple players in a session. Physics synchronizations of items are in optimization development phase and it can cause temporary bugs until a future update. 
[olist]
[*] Placing items in holes or boats can be buggy. 
[*] Item synchronization stops when picking it up and later when dropping the item, synchronization is on agan and a visual bug can appear that smoothly moves the item from picking up position to dropping position.
[*] etc..
[/olist]

[h2][u]Update notes:[/u][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added testing possibility to invite Steam friend to lobby or join to Steam friend (issues and errors could occur)
[*] Added Linux and macOS support for testing purposes (Steam integration not working yet; eg. achievements, friend invite)

[*] Changed splash image
[*] Changed inventory UI color shades
[*] Changed item icons

[*] Fixed alcohol level stucked and couldn't be cleared
[*] Fixed possible error that could prevent pooping
[*] Fixed a few physics synchronization (mostly related to boat)
[*] Fixed time manipulator lever interactivity on client side
[*] Fixed some nullref exceptions in log
[*] Fixed Quit button in main menu
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.4.250226-v0.4.250301
notes.notes:
[i]Last update log is missing (v0.4.250226) so here is the merged one with the newest update in one list:[/i]

[list]
[*] Added light with real time shadow to rescued spirit
[*] Added new command to open log folder (OpenLogFolder)

[*] Changed time scale frrom 0.5 to 1
[*] Increased average shadow brightness
[*] Increased perc-camera lights limit from 32 to 64
[*] Reduced main menu music volume
[*] Reduced unnecessary debug logs
[*] Turned off shadow casting on all additional lights (item and dungeon prop torches too)
[*] Optimized overall memory management across all scripts
[*] Optimized (minor) graphics and texture handling settings for better GPU and CPU performance
[*] Optimized audio settings for better memory usage

[*] Fixed selection outline queue offset (layer order) to be the selected always visible
[*] Fixed seat interactable selection when sitting and changing item slot
[*] Fixed interactable UI layer to be visible through walls (mostly seats had wrong UI layers)
[*] Fixed errors when leaving lobby (null reference in Outline or in InputSettings)
[*] Fixed SceneManager events invoked incrementally as players rejoinned to lobby
[*] Fixed when player jumped during magic ball spectate and it pushed the player away from interaction zone
[/list]
